sentences.en: Can someone watch a lot of porn or have a lot of sex and still not have a problem?
sentences.zh: 一个人看很多色情片或者有很多性行为，但依然没有问题，这可能吗？

sentences.en: Because when we hear words like porn addiction, compulsive sex, or even chem sex, it can be very easy to focus on how often somebody is doing something.
sentences.zh: 因为当我们听到色情成瘾、强迫性性行为甚至化学性爱这样的词汇时，很容易把注意力集中在某人做这件事的频率上。

sentences.en: But the more important question might be, does it still feel like a choice?
sentences.zh: 但更重要的问题可能是，这感觉仍然是一种选择吗？

sentences.en: Today, I'm joined by clinical psychologist, Dr. Maurizio Alvarez to explore what compulsive sexual behaviour actually is,
sentences.zh: 今天，我邀请到了临床心理学家毛里齐奥·阿尔瓦雷斯博士，来探讨什么是真正的强迫性性行为，

sentences.en: why people can get stuck in these cycles, what role shame plays, and what helps people to make lasting change.
sentences.zh: 为什么人们会陷入这些循环，羞耻感扮演了什么角色，以及什么能帮助人们做出持久的改变。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent and this is Psychology Actually.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，这里是《心理学解密》。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to Psychology Actually.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《心理学解密》。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, a qualified clinical psychologist, and I'm delighted to be welcoming a fellow qualified clinical psychologist to the podcast, Dr. Maurizio Alvarez.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名合格的临床心理学家，我很高兴能在播客中迎来另一位合格的临床心理学家同仁，毛里齐奥·阿尔瓦雷斯博士。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗨，玛丽安。

sentences.en: Good to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Lovely to see you as well.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: And this has been a long time in the making, so thanks for sticking with me by emails and cancellations and all of the chaos that I've brought to us.
sentences.zh: 这个节目筹备了很久，谢谢你一直包容我的邮件、取消预约以及我带给我们的种种混乱。

sentences.en: So, we are today thinking about all things porn, chem sex, and compulsive sex.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们今天要探讨所有关于色情片、化学性爱和强迫性性行为的话题。

sentences.en: I thought it might be kind of a nice chance to dive straight into some of the topic with some quick fire questions.
sentences.zh: 我想这可能是一个很好的机会，用几个快问快答直接切入一些话题。

sentences.en: How does that sound to you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: That sounds good.
sentences.zh: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: Okay, question one.
sentences.zh: 好的，第一个问题。

sentences.en: Can someone have a lot of sex or watch a lot of porn, for example, without it necessarily being compulsive?
sentences.zh: 例如，一个人可以有很多性行为或看很多色情片，而这并不一定具有强迫性吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: I think the way that I think of it is it really depends on, it's not so much about the frequency, it's more about the level of control and choice that people feel they have.
sentences.zh: 我认为我的看法是，这很大程度上取决于——与其说是频率问题，不如说是人们感受到的控制感和选择权的水平。

sentences.en: So, there's no set number or frequency.
sentences.zh: 所以，并没有固定的数字或频率。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Okay, question two.
sentences.zh: 好的，第二个问题。

sentences.en: Is porn addiction actually a clinical diagnosis?
sentences.zh: 色情成瘾实际上是一个临床诊断吗？

sentences.en: It is not at the moment.
sentences.zh: 目前还不是。

sentences.en: The DSM, the manual for diagnosis, doesn't include it.
sentences.zh: 《精神疾病诊断与统计手册》（DSM）没有将其纳入。

sentences.en: The ICD-10 does include compulsive sexual behaviours as a broader category, and porn is one of the more common ones.
sentences.zh: 《国际疾病分类》（ICD-10）确实将强迫性性行为列为一个更广泛的类别，而色情片是其中较为常见的一种。

sentences.en: But there's no such thing or a specific diagnosis on porn addiction.
sentences.zh: 但并没有针对色情成瘾的具体诊断这种说法。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Okay, question three.
sentences.zh: 好的，第三个问题。

sentences.en: Can compulsive sex show up in other clinical ways, rather than necessarily someone turning up and presenting and saying,
sentences.zh: 强迫性性行为会不会以其他临床方式表现出来，而不是必然有人出现并直截了当地说，

sentences.en: I've got an issue with sex?
sentences.zh: “我和性有问题”？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, maybe for context, when I work in the NHS as part of the sexual health clinic, we do get the presentations that mention it in those more explicit terMs.
sentences.zh: 是的，为了提供背景，当我在英国国民保健署（NHS）的性健康诊所工作时，我们确实会遇到用这些更露骨的术语来提及它的情况。

sentences.en: But I would say that in private practice, I tend to find these issues when people are talking about their mood, about depression, about some shame and stigma.
sentences.zh: 但我想说的是，在私人诊所里，我往往在人们谈论他们的情绪、抑郁、以及一些羞耻感和污名化时发现这些问题。

sentences.en: So, usually, it's something that you need to dig a little bit deeper from the surface.
sentences.zh: 所以，通常这是你需要从表面往下深挖一点的东西。

sentences.en: But if you don't ask these questions, it might just look like it's depression, when it might actually be that they feel stuck on a pattern.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不问这些问题，它可能看起来只是抑郁，而实际上可能是他们感到被困在某种模式中了。

sentences.en: So, I think it's all about the type of questions that we ask clients.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这完全取决于我们向客户提出的问题类型。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Shame can just wreak havoc on people's lives.
sentences.zh: 羞耻感会对人们的生活造成毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: So, it's a really important area to cover.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常重要的领域，需要去涵盖。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I think shame is what we most keep an eye out, because that tends to be the fuel for what keeps the cycle going.
sentences.zh: 我认为羞耻感是我们最需要密切关注的，因为这往往是维持整个循环运转的燃料。

sentences.en: The secretiveness, keeping it quiet, not mentioning anything.
sentences.zh: 秘密行事、保持沉默、绝口不提。

sentences.en: That's when people tend to get stuck on the loop.
sentences.zh: 这就是人们往往会陷入死循环的时候。

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Okay, question four.
sentences.zh: 好的，第四个问题。

sentences.en: We're talking a little bit about something called chemsex today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天正在讨论一种叫做“化学性爱”（chemsex）的东西。

sentences.en: Could you maybe tell our audience what that is, and whether people can then make lasting changes in their relationship with chemsex or compulsive sex?
sentences.zh: 你能否向我们的听众介绍一下那是什么，以及人们是否能够对他们与化学性爱或强迫性性行为的关系做出持久的改变？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So, chemsex, also known as party and play or sexualized drug use, it's the combination of specific psychoactive substances in the context of sex.
sentences.zh: 化学性爱，也被称为派对与玩耍或性化药物使用，是指在性行为的背景下结合使用特定的精神活性物质。

sentences.en: This might be in order to enhance the experience, to facilitate sex, to manage the shame and manage certain emotions.
sentences.zh: 这可能是为了增强体验、促进性行为、管理羞耻感以及应对某些情绪。

sentences.en: And it is a type of compulsive sexual behavior or out-of-control sex, as we also know it.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所知，它是强迫性性行为或失控性行为的一种。

sentences.en: And yes, there can be long-standing changes when it comes to compulsive sex.
sentences.zh: 是的，在涉及强迫性性行为时，确实可以做出长期的改变。

sentences.en: It's more about learning how to, well, we need to understand the behavior, what the function of it is, what people engaging in these behaviors are trying to get out of that.
sentences.zh: 这更多的是关于学习如何——我们需要理解这种行为，它的功能是什么，参与这些行为的人试图从中得到什么。

sentences.en: And once you identify it and, you know, change the source of the problem or the function of the behavior
sentences.zh: 一旦你识别了它，并且，你知道，改变了问题的根源或行为的功能，

sentences.en: or replace the behavior with something just as useful, people are able to maintain it.
sentences.zh: 或者用同样有用的东西来替代这种行为，人们就能够维持这种改变。

sentences.en: However, it can take some time, so it's just something to bear in mind.
sentences.zh: 然而，这需要一些时间，所以这只是需要牢记的一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, out-of-control sex sounds like that might be something that people would strive for, like it's like hedonistic and out of this world, but it really isn't that, is it?
sentences.zh: 是的，失控的性行为听起来像是人们会去追求的东西，就像享乐主义一样超凡脱俗，但实际上并非如此，对吧？

sentences.en: It usually starts off like that.
sentences.zh: 它通常是从那样开始的。

sentences.en: It's, I think that's what's interesting about this line of work, that we're talking about highly rewarding behaviors,
sentences.zh: 我想这正是这类工作有趣的地方，我们讨论的是高度奖赏性的行为，

sentences.en: things that make you feel connected and seen and desired, and, you know, that you, it's a very intimate way of interacting with people.
sentences.zh: 那些让你感到被连接、被看见和被渴望的事情，你知道，这是一种非常亲密的与人互动的方式。

sentences.en: And that's usually the hook.
sentences.zh: 而这通常就是诱饵所在。

sentences.en: The problem is that it's so rewarding that it can embed long-standing habits,
sentences.zh: 问题在于，它的奖赏机制太强了，以至于会根深蒂固地形成长期习惯，

sentences.en: unless you find something just as rewarding as sex can be.
sentences.zh: 除非你能找到一样能与性相媲美、同样具有奖赏性的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's funny, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，这很有趣，不是吗？

sentences.en: The word intimacy is really, really interesting in, in sex.
sentences.zh: “亲密感”这个词在性当中真的非常非常有趣。

sentences.en: Because actually it's possible to have really great sex with someone that you are not at all emotionally intimate with.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，你完全可以和一个你在情感上一点也不亲密的人拥有非常棒的性体验。

sentences.en: We're talking about sexual intimacy, but it can be a very muddied, a very muddied water presentation-wise, can't it?
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是身体上的亲密，但在表现上这可能会是一个非常混杂、非常混乱的局面，不是吗？

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And we're talking about drugs that part of the effect they have is to promote the sense of connection and emotional intimacy.
sentences.zh: 而且我们所讨论的药物，其部分作用就是促进连接感和情感上的亲密感。

sentences.en: It's a, yeah, it's a chemically induced intimacy.
sentences.zh: 这是一种，是的，这是一种通过化学手段诱导出的亲密感。

sentences.en: And part of, at least working with chem sex, it involves a lot of understanding what people mean when they say intimacy.
sentences.zh: 在处理化学性爱的工作中，至少有一部分需要大量理解人们在说“亲密”时究竟是什么意思。

sentences.en: Is it that it's intimate because it's two naked bodies in front of each other?
sentences.zh: 是因为面前有两具赤裸的身体，所以才觉得亲密吗？

sentences.en: And that in itself is quite, it can be, it's a form of intimacy.
sentences.zh: 这本身就很强，它可以是，这是一种亲密的形式。

sentences.en: Or is it something about feeling seen and understood and being part of, which is what some of these drugs generate.
sentences.zh: 还是说，这与感到被看见、被理解以及成为其中一部分有关，而这正是其中一些药物所产生的效果。

sentences.en: You feel really connected and you feel really, really known and seen by the person that you're with.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得与伴侣真正建立起了连接，并且觉得真正被你身边的这个人所了解和看见。

sentences.en: So untangling both of them can take some, it can be quite tricky.
sentences.zh: 因此，将这两者剥离开来需要花费一些功夫，可能会相当棘手。

sentences.en: So interesting.
sentences.zh: 太有趣了。

sentences.en: I can't wait to get into that.
sentences.zh: 我等不及要深入探讨了。

sentences.en: One more quickfire question.
sentences.zh: 还有一个快问快答。

sentences.en: Okay, question five.
sentences.zh: 好的，第五个问题。

sentences.en: What is surprising to you as a clinician about this work?
sentences.zh: 作为一名临床医生，这项工作中有哪些让你感到惊讶的地方？

sentences.en: For me as a clinician is the answers that I get from people and kind of understanding each person's own erotic template.
sentences.zh: 对我作为临床医生而言，是我从人们那里得到的答案，以及某种程度上对每个人自身的“情欲模板”的理解。

sentences.en: We know the instruction booklet of what turns us on, what turns us off, what kind of things we seek and understand.
sentences.zh: 我们知道那本指导手册：什么能让我们兴奋，什么让我们扫兴，我们追求和理解什么样的事物。

sentences.en: And that's where I find most surprises.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，我发现了最多的惊喜。

sentences.en: But sometimes it's through those conversations that you get to the nitty gritty, that you understand what the person is actually looking for.
sentences.zh: 但有时正是通过这些对话，你才能触及核心，理解这个人真正在寻找什么。

sentences.en: I think working around sex and working with intimacy is by nature something very personal.
sentences.zh: 我认为围绕性展开的工作以及处理亲密关系的工作，本质上是非常私人的事情。

sentences.en: And people may have different relationship to sex.
sentences.zh: 人们可能对性有着不同的关系。

sentences.en: So it's very hard to be prescriptive.
sentences.zh: 所以很难采取教条式的做法。

sentences.en: It's very hard to have guidelines as to how much is too much, how much is too little, what isn't quote unquote normal sex, what is healthy and unhealthy sex.
sentences.zh: 很难制定出这样的指导方针：多少才算太多，多少才算太少，什么不是所谓的“正常”性行为，什么是健康和不健康的性行为。

sentences.en: So for me, I think that that's what's most surprising is understanding how people conceptualize and frame their own sex lives.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，我认为最令人惊讶的是理解人们如何概念化和构架他们自己的性生活。

sentences.en: Yeah, erotic template, I love it, Mauricio.
sentences.zh: 是的，情欲模板，我太喜欢了，毛里齐奥。

sentences.en: And for me, it's making me think about my first experiences of learning about sex and other people's experience of sex and how varied that erotic template can be.
sentences.zh: 对我和我而言，这让我想起了我最初了解性、以及其他人对性的体验的经历，以及那个情欲模板会有多么丰富多变。

sentences.en: So when I was probably about 14, I bought a book by a lady called Nancy Friday, which was called Women on Top.
sentences.zh: 所以当我大约14岁的时候，我买了一本南希·弗莱德代女士的书，叫做《居上之女》（Women on Top）。

sentences.en: And it was the stories of real women about their sexual fantasies.
sentences.zh: 那是真实女性关于她们性幻想的故事。

sentences.en: And it was just so mind-blowing, really.
sentences.zh: 真的非常震撼。

sentences.en: But also, I guess, really de-shaming, really de-stigmatizing and, I don't know, like arousing.
sentences.zh: 但我想，它也确实消除了羞耻感，去除了污名化，并且，我不知道，就像唤起欲望一样。

sentences.en: Some of them were arousing.
sentences.zh: 其中一些确实能唤起欲望。

sentences.en: And that was, I guess, a safe, curious way of exploring that.
sentences.zh: 我想那是一种安全、充满好奇心的方式去探索这些。

sentences.en: But I know that's not always people's first experience of sex and eroticism.
sentences.zh: 但我知道这并不总是人们对性和情欲的最初体验。

sentences.en: Is that fair to say?
sentences.zh: 这样说公平吗？

sentences.en: It is fair to say.
sentences.zh: 这样说很公平。

sentences.en: And I think that's where complexity lies, that everybody approached and learned about sex in different ways.
sentences.zh: 我认为复杂性就在这里，每个人接触和了解性的方式都不同。

sentences.en: For some, it's been a very positive, reassuring, exciting experience.
sentences.zh: 对一些人来说，这是一次非常积极、令人安心且兴奋的体验。

sentences.en: For many others, it's more traumatic and unwanted and enforced.
sentences.zh: 而对许多其他人来说，则更具创伤性、非自愿且是被迫的。

sentences.en: I'm also thinking of age.
sentences.zh: 我也在考虑年龄的问题。

sentences.en: You're mentioning the development and your own earlier experiences and at what time we all find out about sex, find out about sexual exchanges, find out about intimacy.
sentences.zh: 你提到了成长经历、你早期的经历，以及我们都在什么时间点发现性、发现性交流、发现亲密关系。

sentences.en: And I'm just keeping in mind, you know, some of the data from, you know, research around children and young people.
sentences.zh: 我心里一直记着，你知道的，来自儿童和青少年研究的一些数据。

sentences.en: And I find it really shocking that most people find out about porn, for instance, or find their first approximation around the age of 13.
sentences.zh: 我发现一件非常令人震惊的事，大多数人大约在13岁左右发现了色情片，或者说找到了他们的第一次接触。

sentences.en: It's almost a quarter of young people find out before the age or around the age of 11.
sentences.zh: 几乎有四分之一的年轻人甚至在11岁之前或11岁左右就知道了。

sentences.en: So we're talking about a very early point in life when there's very little understanding of what it is.
sentences.zh: 所以我们谈论的是生命中非常早期的阶段，当时对那是什么几乎没有什么理解。

sentences.en: For many, it's very confusing and shocking and scary.

sentences.en: But I wouldn't narrow this down to just pornography.
sentences.zh: 但我不会把这仅仅局限于色情制品。

sentences.en: This is something that we're also struggling in social media around narratives, around identity, gender, behavior, relationships, you know, the relationship between men and women,
sentences.zh: 这也是我们在社交媒体上关于身份、性别、行为、关系的叙事中正在苦苦挣扎的问题，你知道的，男人和女人之间的关系，

sentences.en: the role of men in society.

sentences.en: So we are living in a society that is overwhelmed with content and information, and this includes pornography.

sentences.en: So this is inevitably going to affect the way that you relate to sex and how you perceive your own sex life.

sentences.zh: 至于你问题的第二部分，根本没有“正常的性”这种东西。

sentences.zh: 我不会用正常和不正常来界定。

sentences.zh: 我们或许更多地是从咨询室里什么更常见或更普遍的角度来思考。

sentences.en: There are certain practices that are shared by more people.
sentences.zh: 有些实践是更多人所共享的。

sentences.en: There are others, for instance, certain types of kink, certain types of fantasies that might be less ordinary.
sentences.zh: 而其他的，比如某些类型的性癖，某些可能没那么寻常的幻想。

sentences.en: But I would try to avoid framing things as normal, abnormal, healthy, or unhealthy, because what classifies them as such is really the function, the outcome of the behavior,
sentences.zh: 但我会尽量避免将事物框定为正常、不正常、健康或不健康，因为真正将它们分类的是行为的功能、结果，

sentences.en: and how people feel about it.
sentences.zh: 以及人们对它的感觉。

sentences.en: It might be a very normal type of sex, but people may feel ashamed, I think case in point, with vanilla sex, which is normal by nature, but seems boring, seems not very creative.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一种非常正常的性行为，但人们可能会感到羞耻，我想这就好比“普通性”（vanilla sex），按理说它本是很自然的，但似乎显得很无聊，显得不那么有创造力。

sentences.en: So I would just question and challenge that with clients.
sentences.zh: 所以我只会与客户一起去质疑和挑战这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think, you know, vanilla sex is great, but you might not want vanilla every day.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且我认为，你知道的，普通性很棒，但你可能并不想每天都过这种生活。

sentences.en: But whatever variety of sex you're having, it needs to be consensual, needs to be legal as well.
sentences.zh: 但无论你进行何种多样化的性行为，它都必须是双方同意的，也必须是合法的。

sentences.en: And hopefully, if you're doing this with multiple partners, it needs to be safe.
sentences.zh: 而且希望如此，如果你与多个伴侣进行这种行为，它必须是安全的。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我会说这类似于卫生习惯，你洗手是有原因的，你每隔一段时间洗个澡以确保周围每个人，你知道的，

sentences.zh: 但它是如此被污名化，以至于我们往往把它抛在一边，尽量不去想它，仿佛这样做就能让我们的性健康保持活力一样。

sentences.en: And, you know, it seems like these are some of the difficulties that are underneath these narratives, you know, maybe men that are finding it difficult to sit with their feelings,

sentences.en: But I think that talking about body autonomy, as you're talking about, I like the way that you're framing that autonomy around boundaries, around, you know, different bodies,

sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: Okay, so clinically, what might effective treatment for chemsex, compulsive sex, excessive porn use, what might that look like?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么从临床角度来看，针对化工性爱（chemsex）、强迫性性行为、过度使用色情内容，有效的治疗会是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, there's this great book by Silva Neves called Compulsive Sexual Behaviors.
sentences.zh: 嗯，Silva Neves写过一本很棒的书叫《强迫性性行为》。

sentences.en: It's a clinician's guide and I couldn't recommend it more.
sentences.zh: 这是一本临床医生指南，我极力推荐。

sentences.en: That's the model that I use to work with these presentations.
sentences.zh: 这就是我用来处理这些情况的模型。

sentences.en: Of course, there's evidence around acceptance and commitment therapy.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有围绕接纳承诺疗法（ACT）的证据。

sentences.en: There's therapy around CBT, but psychosexually speaking, the way that I tend to work, and that seems to be quite helpful, is to start off with emotion regulation,
sentences.zh: 有围绕认知行为疗法（CBT）的治疗，但从性心理学角度来说，我倾向于使用且证明相当有效的方法是，从情绪调节开始，

sentences.en: to understand the function of the behavior.
sentences.zh: 去理解这种行为的功能。

sentences.en: What is the emotion that sex is having on this person's life?
sentences.zh: 性行为在这个人的生活中起到了什么情绪作用？

sentences.en: What emotion is being regulated?
sentences.zh: 到底在调节什么情绪？

sentences.en: Is it around loneliness?
sentences.zh: 是关于孤独吗？

sentences.en: Is it boredom?
sentences.zh: 是无聊吗？

sentences.en: Is it shame?
sentences.zh: 是羞耻吗？

sentences.en: Is it relational loss, relationship breakdown?
sentences.zh: 是关系丧失、关系破裂吗？

sentences.en: What's going on there?
sentences.zh: 那里面到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: What's the pain that someone's covering?
sentences.zh: 别人在掩盖什么痛苦？

sentences.en: And to develop those skills.
sentences.zh: 并培养这些技能。

sentences.en: So that's why ACT, DBT, CBT, that are very strong on developing skills and skills practice, they work well.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么ACT、DBT、CBT在培养技能和技能练习方面非常强，它们效果很好。

sentences.en: You know, once you develop the function and the other skill to navigate it, then the problem, most of the time, it goes on its own or it regulates itself.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一旦你搞清楚了功能以及应对它的其他技能，那么问题在大多数情况下就会自行消失或自我调节。

sentences.en: Second stage, I would look into more processing.
sentences.zh: 第二阶段，我会深入探讨加工处理。

sentences.en: Perhaps when there's enough emotion regulation, many people do EMDr.
sentences.zh: 也许当有足够的情绪调节时，许多人会做眼动脱敏再加工（EMDR）。

sentences.en: They might be doing some trauma processing.
sentences.zh: 他们可能在做一些创伤处理。

sentences.en: They may be doing some narrative work.
sentences.zh: 他们可能在做一些叙事疗法工作。

sentences.en: And the third stage would be around integration and bringing it all in together.
sentences.zh: 第三阶段将是关于整合以及把所有这些结合在一起。

sentences.en: I think that's something very useful in helping a client trace back where it all started.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对于帮助来访者追溯这一切的起点非常有用。

sentences.en: So this was the I was trying to navigate loneliness because I was surrounded by I was, you know, an only child, for instance.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我当时试图应对孤独的方式，因为我被包围在……比如我是一个独生子女。

sentences.en: And this is an important emotion that I never learned to navigate.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我从未学会如何应对的重要情绪。

sentences.en: Then you work around the loneliness of being an only child of neglect or of abandonment, whatever might be going underneath.
sentences.zh: 然后你围绕身为独生子女的孤独、被忽视或被抛弃的感觉来进行工作，无论潜在原因是什么。

sentences.en: And then the person can string it all together and say, well, actually, what I was hoping for was to find someone that would make me feel less lonely.
sentences.zh: 然后这个人就可以把所有这些串联起来说，嗯，实际上，我一直希望的是找到一个能让我不那么孤独的人。

sentences.en: And when I feel very lonely, this is what I do.
sentences.zh: 而当我感到非常孤独时，这就是我会做的事。

sentences.en: But now I understand that based on my trauma, there's a different context.
sentences.zh: 但现在我明白，基于我的创伤，这里有一个不同的背景。

sentences.en: So I would do it like in many other interventions where you start with the stabilization, then you do a little bit of processing and understanding,
sentences.zh: 所以我会像许多其他干预措施一样去做，先从稳定化开始，然后做一点处理和理解，

sentences.en: and then you integrate it all together.
sentences.zh: 接着把它们全部整合在一起。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So they're de-shaming, the psychoeducation, the processing of any trauma, and they're giving them the tools to do things differently, more intentionally,
sentences.zh: 所以它们包括消除羞耻、心理教育、任何创伤的处理，以及赋予他们以不同方式、更有意图、

sentences.en: more mindfully and consciously to have, I guess, ultimately a better relationship with themselves,
sentences.zh: 更正念、更有意识地做事工具，我想，最终与自己建立更好的关系，

sentences.en: but to have potentially the ability to have a more functional relationship with whoever it is you want to have relationships with.
sentences.zh: 并且潜在地具备与你想要建立关系的人建立更具功能性的关系的能力。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And I just want to add there that, you know, I mentioned trauma processing as an important feature,
sentences.zh: 我只想补充一点，你知道的，我提到创伤处理是一个重要特征，

sentences.en: but it's really useful to remember that not all compulsive sexual behaviors come from trauma, that trauma is an important predictor, that it is very highly correlated, because,
sentences.zh: 但记住这一点非常有用：并非所有强迫性性行为都源于创伤，创伤是一个重要的预测因素，它具有极高的相关性，因为，

sentences.en: you know, trauma is known to affect our ability to regulate ourselves and control our behavior.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，众所周知，创伤会影响我们自我调节和控制行为的能力。

sentences.en: But it doesn't mean that everybody that is struggling with managing their behavior,
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着每一个在管理自己行为上有困难的人，

sentences.en: but it doesn't mean that everybody that is struggling with managing their porn use or masturbation or sex has gone through trauma.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着每一个在控制色情观看、手淫或性行为方面苦苦挣扎的人都经历过创伤。

sentences.en: It's just something to keep in mind.
sentences.zh: 这只是需要牢记的一点。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And this really does impact on people's relationships.
sentences.zh: 这确实对人们的亲密关系产生了影响。

sentences.en: So people in kind of committed relationships will often struggle with their partner's porn use or what that says about them, whether they're maybe not enough or not fulfilling it.
sentences.zh: 因此，处于承诺关系中的人经常会与伴侣观看色情内容的问题作斗争，或者纠结这说明了什么，比如自己是否不够好或无法满足对方。

sentences.en: And is it fair to say that, that for some people, it feels entirely separate to their relationship with their actual partner?
sentences.zh: 这样说是否公平：对某些人来说，这感觉与他们和真实伴侣的关系完全无关？

sentences.en: It does bring a lot of tension.
sentences.zh: 这确实带来了很多紧张情绪。

sentences.en: There are also cultural components that might make this tension stronger.
sentences.zh: 还有一些文化因素可能会加剧这种紧张。

sentences.en: I think what's useful is to think about whose problem this is, you know, one thing it can, there can be a relationship where one of the partners watches porn consistently,
sentences.zh: 我认为有用的是去思考这到底是谁的问题，你知道的，可能存在这样一种关系：其中一个伴侣经常看色情片，

sentences.en: but there is a conversation about that, there's openness about it, there's clarity.
sentences.zh: 但他们对此有交流、有开放的态度、有清晰的沟通。

sentences.en: And it's also, you know, our own right to enjoy our own bodies in our own private space and, you know, to self-pleasure.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，在自己的私密空间里享受自己的身体以及自我抚慰，也是我们自己的权利。

sentences.en: That's also important.
sentences.zh: 这也是很重要的。

sentences.en: But it's useful to think about in the relationship who think it's a problem.
sentences.zh: 但思考在关系中究竟是谁认为这是一个问题，会很有用。

sentences.en: The one watching porn might not think it's a difficulty because they feel they are still well embedded in the relationship.
sentences.zh: 看色情片的人可能不认为这是一个困难，因为他们觉得自己在关系中仍然根基稳固。

sentences.en: The other one might be feeling excluded, discarded, dismissed, depending on their own internal templates.
sentences.zh: 另一个人可能会感到被排除在外、被抛弃、被无视，这取决于他们自身的内部心智模式。

sentences.en: So in that case,
sentences.zh: 所以在这种情况下，

sentences.en: I would be working more with a partner that feels that there is an issue rather than just blank slate saying people in relationships that watch porn need to go to couples counseling because that's not the case.
sentences.zh: 我会更多地与觉得有问题的那个伴侣合作，而不是一概而论地说，看色情片的恋爱中人需要去做伴侣咨询，因为事实并非如此。

sentences.en: You know, it's a, there are couples that work through it well.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有些伴侣能很好地解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And the other way around, it might be that for one of the partners, they're absolutely fine with the partner watching pornography, but the partner, even despite the reassurance,
sentences.zh: 反过来也是如此，可能其中一个伴侣对对方看色情片完全没有意见，但看色情片的那个伴侣，尽管得到了安慰，

sentences.en: they might feel very ashamed.
sentences.zh: 仍然会感到非常羞耻。

sentences.en: And in that case, that's something that you need to work with a person that is struggling with the shame around porn.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，你需要与那个正饱受色情内容带来的羞耻感折磨的人一起工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, really important.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常重要。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And then just before we finish, you know, people will be engaging with this content for a variety of reasons,
sentences.zh: 最后在结束之前，你知道的，人们接触这些内容的原因各不相同，

sentences.en: but we can't discount that there might be people watching this who, who compulsive pornography, chem sex and kind of very, very high sex drive is, is around for them.
sentences.zh: 但我们不能忽视这样一个事实：可能有人在收听或观看这个内容，他们正深受强迫性色情内容、化工性爱以及非常高亢的性欲所困扰。

sentences.en: What would you, what would you say to them in this position?
sentences.zh: 处于这种处境的他们，你会对他们说些什么？

sentences.en: I would say that it's important to start the conversation, that it's very likely that they will be feeling isolated, excluded.
sentences.zh: 我会说，开始对话是很重要的，他们很有可能会感到孤立、被排斥。

sentences.en: These are kind of, these kinds of presentations,
sentences.zh: 这些类型的情况，

sentences.en: they're so connected to shame that they intrinsically make us hide and avoid and pretend that nothing's happening until it's too big and it explodes.
sentences.zh: 它们与羞耻感紧密相连，以至于它们本能地让我们隐藏、回避并假装什么都没发生，直到问题变得太大而爆发。

sentences.en: I would say that there's nothing wrong with you.
sentences.zh: 我想说，你并没有什么问题。

sentences.en: You're not broken.
sentences.zh: 你并没有坏掉。

sentences.en: You are, you know, the sense of feeling out of control has, in most cases, very little to do with willpower and very much to do with habits,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那种失控感在大多数情况下，其实与意志力关系不大，而与习惯有很大关系，

sentences.en: with what we pay attention to and to how embedded we, how, yeah, how well embedded we feel in our, in our lives.
sentences.zh: 与我们关注的事情有关，也与我们融入生活、融入得有多深有很大关系。

sentences.en: So I would recommend them to reach out to, you know, usually a good place to start is either in sexual health clinics that you can reach out.
sentences.zh: 所以我建议他们去寻求帮助，通常一个好的起点是你可以联系的性健康诊所。

sentences.en: It's important to know, to clarify that not all sexual health clinics provide support for pornography, for instance.
sentences.zh: 需要知道並澄清的是，并非所有性健康诊所都提供例如针对色情制品的帮助。

sentences.en: There are specialist services to do that.
sentences.zh: 有专门的服务来做这件事。

sentences.en: But being able to express this to your health advice or in a sexual health setting, they might be able to signpost you to the services that they, that could actually help.
sentences.zh: 但能够向你的健康顾问或在性健康机构表达这一点，他们也许能够指引你找到真正能提供帮助的服务。

sentences.en: In our clinic, we don't provide support for compulsive pornography use when there is no presence of risk.
sentences.zh: 在我们的诊所，当不存在风险时，我们不为强迫性观看色情制品提供支持。

sentences.en: And in that case, we signpost them.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我们会为他们指引方向。

sentences.en: There's a few services in the country.
sentences.zh: 这个国家有一些这样的服务。

sentences.en: And yeah, I would do my, my attempt at reaching out for support.
sentences.zh: 是的，我会尽我所能去寻求支持。

sentences.en: There is a solution.
sentences.zh: 是有解决办法的。

sentences.en: It can be, things can change, but in order for things to change, one needs to take this tiny little step that feels like a massive jump,
sentences.zh: 情况是可以改变的，但为了让情况有所改变，我们需要迈出一小步，这一步感觉像是一个巨大的跨越，

sentences.en: which is to open up to whoever you find trustworthy and say, I need support with this and I need help in understanding it.
sentences.zh: 那就是向你觉得值得信赖的任何人敞开心扉，说：“我需要这方面的支持，我需要帮助来理解它。”

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 太完美了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about you and your work and where people can find you?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我们简单介绍一下你自己、你的工作以及大家在哪里能找到你吗？

sentences.en: Well, people can find me in two different places.
sentences.zh: 好的，大家可以在两个不同的地方找到我。

sentences.en: The first one would be at the sexual health clinic called All EaSt.
sentences.zh: 第一个是在名为All EaSt的性健康诊所。

sentences.en: That is the Royal London Hospital.
sentences.zh: 那是皇家伦敦医院。

sentences.en: And alternatively, they can find me online.
sentences.zh: 或者，他们也可以在线上找到我。

sentences.en: I've got a website, drmalvers.com.
sentences.zh: 我有一个网站，drmalvers.com。

sentences.en: I also am on social media.
sentences.zh: 我也有社交媒体。

sentences.en: I have a private practice.
sentences.zh: 我有一间私人诊所。

sentences.en: Most of the work I do is through the NHS.
sentences.zh: 我大部分的工作都是通过英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）进行的。

sentences.en: So I don't have that many slots available.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有那么多空闲的名额。

sentences.en: But I am very good at keeping an eye out on my waiting liSt.
sentences.zh: 但我非常擅长留意我的等待名单。

sentences.en: And if I'm not available, I'm also very happy to triage, signpost and send to people that I might be able to help.
sentences.zh: 如果我没空，我也非常乐意进行分诊、指引，并将他们转介给可能帮得上忙的人。

sentences.en: I will send you my details so that you can share them with the listeners.
sentences.zh: 我会把我的详细联系方式发给你，这样你就可以分享给听众了。

sentences.en: I absolutely will do.
sentences.zh: 我一定会这么做的。

sentences.en: And thank you for accepting my slightly weird DM on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你接受我在LinkedIn上略显奇怪的私信。

sentences.en: It's probably not your average DM.
sentences.zh: 这可能不是你平时收到的那种私信。

sentences.en: But somebody had pitched this episode to me in my email inbox.
sentences.zh: 但有人在我的收件箱里向我推介了这一期节目。

sentences.en: And I was like, this conversation is so important.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，这段对话太重要了。

sentences.en: But I really wanted to have it with an HCPC UK psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很想和一位英国健康与护理专业委员会（HCPC）注册心理学家来谈。

sentences.en: And I'm delighted that you said yes.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你答应了。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以，谢谢你。

sentences.en: And thank you for my audience as well.
sentences.zh: 也替我的听众谢谢你。

sentences.en: Because it's a really important conversation to have in safe, qualified, regulated, evidence-based hands.
sentences.zh: 因为在一个安全、合格、受监管且基于实证的专业手中进行这样一场对话真的非常重要。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以，谢谢。

sentences.en: And thank you for the invitation.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你的邀请。

sentences.en: The way that you framed it was great.
sentences.zh: 你切入的方式非常好。

sentences.en: I do this for a living.
sentences.zh: 我以此为生。

sentences.en: So it wasn't weird at all for me.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说一点也不奇怪。

sentences.en: And it made me think about that.
sentences.zh: 这让我想到了这一点：

sentences.en: This is not the only work I do.
sentences.zh: 这不是我做的唯一工作。

sentences.en: I also work with other relationship difficulties.
sentences.zh: 我也处理其他的情感关系困难。

sentences.en: I work with general mental health.
sentences.zh: 我从事一般心理健康工作。

sentences.en: But for those that are struggling with sexual health, I know that it's very hard to find people out there.
sentences.zh: 但对于那些正挣扎于性健康问题的人，我知道要在外面找到相关人员非常困难。

sentences.en: And it's probably very similar to what you experienced in trying to find a speaker for this.
sentences.zh: 这可能和你试图为本期节目寻找嘉宾时的经历非常相似。

sentences.en: So if I can be one person that people can reach out and then we can signpost them, that would be, you know, it's a success on my note.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我能成为大家可以求助的一个人，然后我们能为他们指引方向，你知道的，对我来说这就是成功。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Thank you again for your time.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 谢谢你，玛丽安。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢我的嘉宾毛里西奥·阿尔瓦雷斯博士（Dr. Mauricio Alvarez）抽出时间参加节目。

sentences.zh: 如果你想回顾那一期节目，节目文稿和简介中有详细信息。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚取收入，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”（One-to-Many）计划现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该计划，此后也一直支持两期心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我自己的专属支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场大师班小组辅导、大师课、个性化指导、一份福南梅森（Fortnum & Mason）礼品以及限时的一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
